definitions.explanation: The line or point that separates two areas or things.

examples.notes: [Note: When used as suffix, read ざかい]

examples.japanese: ⟦{生|い}き→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧⟦{死|し}に→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{境|さかい}
examples.english: The boundary between life and death.

examples.japanese: {境|さかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}える→越える：02099_koeru⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}ら→彼ら：01802_karera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{境|さかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{接|せっ}して→接する：12920_sessuru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧。
examples.english: Their houses share a boundary, so they see each other every day.

notes:
{境|さかい} refers to a boundary or dividing line between areas, states, or concepts — both physical and abstract.

PRONUNCIATION:
As a standalone word: さかい. As a suffix in compounds: often voiced to ざかい (⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧{境|ざかい}, ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧{境|ざかい}).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{県|けん}→県：02151_ken⟧{境|ざかい}: prefectural border
- ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧{境|ざかい}: national border
- {境|さかい}⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: borderline, turning point
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{境|さかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: from ~ onwards, since ~
- ⟦{生|い}き→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧⟦{死|し}に→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{境|さかい}: the boundary between life and death

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{境界|きょうかい}→境界：12096_kyoukai⟧: boundary (more formal/technical)
- ⟦{国境|こっきょう}→国境：02762_kokkyou⟧: national border (Sino-Japanese reading)
- ⟦{限界|げんかい}→限界：02715_genkai⟧: limit, boundary (of capability)

The pattern 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{境|さかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is commonly used to mark a turning point: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{境|さかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ (My life changed after marriage).
